stories.title: Sources: Vikings made initial Cousins trade call before MNF meltdown
stories.summary: The Vikings initially reached out to the Raiders about a Kirk Cousins trade before their MNF game against the Bills, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
stories.summary: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

stories.title: Ole Miss-Oklahoma bumped to Sunday despite Sooners AD's 'strong objection'
stories.summary: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny was critical of the SEC's decision to move the Sooners' home game against Ole Miss to Sunday following Friday's nationwide ground stop.

stories.title: NFL reassigns backup referees to work games within driving distance
stories.summary: The NFL, trying to avoid further travel issues from Friday's FAA ground stop, has reassigned officials to Week 10 games within driving distance of their homes.

stories.title: Deion a 'proud guy' as 'resilient' Buffs take down No. 14 Houston
stories.summary: Colorado posted its first victory over an AP top-15 team since 2007 in beating No. 14 Houston 42-32 and slightly cooled down the hot seat for coach Deion Sanders.
